name: Ehrenbachhöhe
beschreibung:
Perched high above Kitzbuehel at 1,800 metres above sea level, Berghotel Ehrenbachhoehe enchants with a 360-degree panorama of the Kitzbuehel Alps and the legendary Hahnenkamm. It pairs authentic alpine romance with upscale hotel amenities.

In winter, guests hit the famous ski pistes right from the front door. Summer unlocks spectacular ridgeway hiking trails and alpine bike tracks.
kurzbeschreibung: Berghotel Ehrenbachhoehe in Kitzbuehel offers exclusive lodging at 1,800 metres right in the heart of the world-famous ski area.
